name: Node Comics GPU 0.1.0 (CUDA 12.8.1)
desc: Node Comics v3 GPU worker: 2 compute pages, 8 in flight, 6 downloads, 6 deliveries. No startup downloads.
readme: Choose Docker ENTRYPOINT mode. Before renting, replace NODE_ID, NODE_TOKEN and NODE_RESOURCE_ID with a newly provisioned independent identity; center execution_slots must be 8. Set NODE_CONTROL_URL if using another HTTPS center. Do not save real tokens into any template or account-wide variables. GPU warmup completes before registration. Inspect instance logs and center heartbeat to confirm readiness. No inbound ports or SSH server are provided. Keep /data for stop/start recovery; drain work and back up before recycle/destroy. Requires x86_64 and NVIDIA Vulkan/graphics drivers; CUDA visibility alone is insufficient. GPU/RAM sizing is a starting requirement, not a throughput guarantee.
